title: 第一章 嫂嫂相助京营有望第二章 熙凤赠银天子亲军
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: “环儿，你个使促狭的！偷了宝玉的命根子，闹得姑娘们也不得安生！”
“环哥儿，这通灵宝玉到底藏哪了？说明了，我们就是受罪，也在明处啊！”
大乾！
六月天，日头毒辣。
荣国府内，一个俊朗少年笔挺的跪在青石砖上，背上却满是鞭子抽打的血痕。
他面色苍白如纸，微垂的双目，闪过不甘和震怒！
“贾环！你若再不将宝玉的通灵宝玉还来，我今儿非打死你不可！”
贾政身穿锦袍，手持长鞭，满脸极怒之色。
但！少年依然将背脊挺得笔直，如同松柏傲立，不曾有半点弯曲。
穿越成红楼人人厌弃的庶子贾环，处处遭偏待也就罢了，现如今，就连贾宝玉弄丢了贴身玩意，都要怪到他头上来。
更可悲的是，这最先起疑的，还是他的亲姐探春！
“你这该打胚子，伤了你事小，可别气坏了二老爷！”
忽而，一道尖利的声音传来。
众人闻声望去，就见一个头戴金丝八宝攒珠髻，穿着缕金百蝶穿花大红洋缎窄裉袄，彩绣辉煌，恍若神妃仙子的卓越少妇款款而来。
其人容貌绝艳，肌肤盛雪，正是十二金钗之一的王熙凤！
“是凤哥儿来了。”
瞧见来人，贾政怒颜也稍稍缓了一些。
“你主意多，快帮我治治这个孽障！早前训斥几句，打上几下，倒也能老实几日，如今是骂也不听，打也不怕！”
“二奶奶，您快救救二爷吧！没了通灵宝玉，二爷这会还在怡红院闹呢！”
麝月红着眼眶，愁得脸都白了。
王熙凤一听，脸色大变，登时玉指一伸，便教训起了贾环！
“亏你还是个爷们，怎还干起了偷鸡摸狗的勾当？真真是叫人错看了！”
贾环抿唇，闷声道：“好嫂子，真不是我，我没拿。”
“没拿？”探春眼神冷冽，讥笑出声，“呵呵，这府邸上下，谁不知道你嫉妒宝玉？上次被罚抄金刚经，你还装作失手，故意把蜡灯推向宝玉！”
“如今这通灵宝玉丢了，除了你，还能是谁？”
贾环略默，藏在袖中的双手紧捏成拳！
人心中的成见就像一座大山，来了半个月，无论他怎么和善待人，都会别扣上一定别有用心的帽子！
作为穿越者，他也有属于自己的金手指——万象出勤系统！
只要每日在军营出出勤，做做任务就可以获得相应奖励。
这一次，他要从军升官，改变命运！用权势镇压一切！
而京营三大营之一的神枢营，便是负责京都日常巡逻，出勤率极高！也是他获取奖励的绝佳之地！
“欲加之罪，何患无辞！”
“好，好一个欲加之罪，何患无词！”
贾政气的身子狂颤，再度扬鞭，“宝玉可是老祖宗的心头肉，你平日荒唐也就罢了，如今是要逼死老祖宗不成！”
啪！
又是一鞭，重重甩下！
content_en:
"Huan'er, you are a pushover! You stole Baoyu's lifeline and made the girls miserable!"
"Brother Huan, where is this psychic gem hidden? It's clear, even if we suffer, it's still in the open!"
"..."
Go for it!
It’s June and the sun is scorching.
In the Rongguo Mansion, a handsome young man was kneeling upright on the bluestone bricks, but his back was covered with blood marks from whips.
His face was as pale as paper, and his slightly lowered eyes flashed with reluctance and anger!
"Jia Huan! If you don't return Baoyu's psychic jade, I will beat you to death today!"
Jia Zheng was wearing a brocade robe, holding a long whip, and his face was filled with anger.
but! The young man still straightened his back, like a pine and cypress standing proudly, without any bend.
Jia Huan, the concubine who traveled through time and was despised by everyone in the Red Mansion, was treated favorably everywhere. Now, even if Jia Baoyu loses his personal belongings, he must be blamed on him.
What's even more tragic is that it was his sister Tanchun who was the first to become suspicious!
"You should have had an abortion. It's not a big deal if it hurts you, but don't make the second master angry!"
Suddenly, a sharp voice came.
When everyone heard the news, they saw an outstanding young woman wearing a golden bun with eight treasures and beads on her head, a narrow-legged coat of gold and red satin with colorful embroidery, and a colorful embroidery. She looked like a concubine or a fairy.
This person's appearance is stunning and her skin is like snow. She is none other than Wang Xifeng, one of the Twelve Golden Hairpins!
"Brother Feng is here."
Seeing the person coming, Jia Zheng's angry face softened a little.
"You have so many ideas, please help me cure this evil! Earlier, a few scoldings and a few slaps would have kept me honest for a few days, but now I don't even listen to scolding, nor am I afraid of being beaten!"
"Second Grandma, please save the Second Master quickly! Without the psychic jade, the Second Master will still be making trouble in Yihong Courtyard!"
She Yue's eyes were red and her face turned pale with worry.
When Wang Xifeng heard this, his expression changed drastically. He stretched out his jade finger and taught Jia Huan a lesson!
"You're still a man, so why are you still engaging in sneaky things? It's really a misunderstanding!"
Jia Huan pursed her lips and said in a low voice: "Good sister-in-law, it's really not me. I didn't take it."
"Didn't take it?" Tanchun's eyes were cold and he laughed sarcastically, "Haha, who in this mansion doesn't know that you are jealous of Baoyu? The last time you were punished to copy the Diamond Sutra, you pretended to miss and pushed the wax lamp towards Baoyu on purpose!"
"Now that this psychic gem is lost, who else could it be besides you?"
Jia Huan was silent for a moment, his hands hidden in his sleeves clenched into fists!
The prejudice in people's hearts is like a big mountain. After half a month, no matter how kindly they treat others, they will always label them as having ulterior motives!
As a time traveler, he also has his own golden finger - the Vientiane Attendance System!
As long as you go to the military camp every day and complete tasks, you can get corresponding rewards.
This time, he wants to be promoted from the army and change his destiny! Use power to suppress everything!
The Shenshu Camp, one of the three major battalions of the Jingying Camp, is responsible for daily patrols in Kyoto, and its attendance rate is extremely high! It’s also a great place for him to get rewards!
"If you want to incriminate yourself, why bother?"
"Okay, if you want to accuse someone, why bother without saying anything!"
Jia Zhengqi's body trembled wildly, and he raised his whip again, "Baoyu is my ancestor's heart. You are just ridiculous on weekdays, but now you are trying to force my ancestor to death!"
Snap!
Another whip, thrown down hard!
title_en: Chapter 1: Sister-in-law is expected to help the Beijing camp Chapter 2: Xifeng gives silver to the Emperor's personal army
